lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows along the lateral flank, exhibiting a semi-regular spatial distribution with peak intensities in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of local maxima nodes most visible between the gills and the dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, primarily clustered towards the anterior edge and the base of the fin structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated shape with lower luminance than the surrounding water is visible attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
